notes.text: We've now fixed the label contrast issue for stacked bar micro chart
We've now fixed the rendering issue of the interactive bar chart while navigating back to list report from an object page
We've fixed an issue where the bar labels within the stacked bar micro chart disappears after navigating back to the main screen due to reduction in chart height
We've now changed the minimum interactive area of interactive microcharts from 48px to 44px
We've now fixed the context menu from incorrectly appearing on right-click when ComparisonMicroChart has no press listeners attached
We've now fixed the missing selected state borders for interactive microcharts in non-high-contrast themes
